title: Promises and async await
description: Practice promises and async await using injected asynchronous operations, deterministic Node 24 tests, cancellation and failure cases with no external network dependency.
objectives: Predict promises and async await behavior before executing an asynchronous operation
Diagnose the starter's race, ordering or error-handling defect
Prove cancellation, ordering or failure behavior with deterministic offline tests
rubric: I can explain the scheduler, cancellation or failure rule in promises and async await.
I reproduce a failing starter with a real Promise or injected transport.
I verify the success and failure paths without public network calls.
